summary: Compile and static guardrails pass, but the signal-flip ordering violates the approved card's atomic reverse and one-position contract.

findings.title: Opposite entry can occur before the existing position is closed
findings.detail: OnTick calls Strategy_ManageOpenPosition before QM_IsNewBar and Strategy_PrepareWeeklySignal. The freshly computed opposite g_cached_direction is therefore unavailable to the close path on the new-bar tick. Strategy_EntrySignal rejects only a same-direction owned position and proceeds when the owned position is opposite, so a hedging account can briefly hold both directions and a netting account can flatten instead of close-and-reopen. This contradicts the card's atomic signal-flip and one-position-per-magic rules.
